cute.name: Cute
cute.description: Soft colours, tiny shapes and happy little details. Charms, Hippers and stickers for anyone whose bag, phone or hair clip should look like a good mood.
cute.seoDesc: Soft, sweet charms, Hippers, 3D stickers and DIY kits in pastel colours and tiny shapes. Cash on delivery available.

bold.name: Bold
bold.description: Loud colours, chunky shapes and no apologies. Pieces for people who want their bag, jacket or hair clip to be noticed from across the room.
bold.seoDesc: Chunky, high-contrast charms, Hippers, 3D stickers and DIY kits for people who like to stand out. Cash on delivery available.

overthinking.name: Overthinking
overthinking.description: For the one who rereads the message six times. Quiet jokes, worried little faces and charms that understand your 2 a.m. thoughts.
overthinking.heroCopy: Thought about it. Still want it.
overthinking.seoDesc: Charms, Hippers, 3D stickers and DIY kits with dry humour for people who think too much. Cash on delivery available.

gothic.name: Gothic
gothic.description: Dark enamel, silver tones and a little drama. Charms and clips for people who prefer moonlight to sunshine.
gothic.seoDesc: Moody charms, Hippers, 3D stickers and DIY kits in black, silver and deep jewel tones. Cash on delivery available.

funky.name: Funky
funky.description: Retro swirls, bright clashes and seventies energy. Playful pieces that turn a plain tote or phone case into a groove.
funky.heroCopy: Groovy little things, made to clash.
funky.seoTitle: Funky retro charms, Hippers and stickers
funky.seoDesc: Bright, retro-inspired charms, Hippers, 3D stickers and DIY kits with serious seventies energy. Cash on delivery available.

charms.name: Charms
charms.definition: Small decorative pieces that hang from your bag, keys, phone or zip. Made from zinc alloy or stainless steel with enamel, resin or acrylic details.
charms.seoTitle: Charms for bags, keys and phones
charms.seoDesc: Shop charms in every vibe: cute, bold, overthinking, gothic and funky. Enamel, resin and acrylic details on zinc alloy or steel.

hippers.name: Hippers
hippers.definition: Hippers are our clip-on accessories: snap clips, claw clips and bag hooks with a charm-like personality. Clip one into your hair, onto a tote strap, a belt loop or a zip pull, and move it to something else whenever your vibe changes. No tools, no piercing, nothing permanent.
hippers.seoDesc: Hippers are clip-on snap clips, claw clips and bag hooks. Wear them in your hair or on a tote, belt loop or zip pull. No piercing.

3d-stickers.name: 3D Stickers
3d-stickers.definition: Layered vinyl stickers with a clear domed resin top, so they feel raised and glossy. Stick them on phone cases, laptops, bottles and notebooks.
3d-stickers.seoTitle: 3D stickers with a glossy domed finish
3d-stickers.seoDesc: Layered vinyl 3D stickers with a clear domed resin top. Add them to phone cases, laptops, bottles and notebooks.

diy-accessories.name: DIY Accessories
diy-accessories.definition: DIY kits with glass, acrylic and polymer-clay beads plus stainless-steel rings and findings, so you can make your own charms and accessories at home.
diy-accessories.seoTitle: DIY accessory kits with beads and findings
diy-accessories.seoDesc: Make your own charms and accessories with DIY kits of glass, acrylic and polymer-clay beads and stainless-steel findings.
